note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on rollback planning (metadata vs. data rollback, forward fix, feature toggling, scoped reversal) for Salesforce deployments. The core claim -- that Salesforce deployment tooling does not automatically retain a 'previous version' package, and that data already changed by deployed automation is not restored by reverting metadata -- is standard, well-established Salesforce release-engineering practice and does not rest on an invented API, feature name, or numeric limit. No screenshots used per this course's conceptual/architecture policy.
